# Metrics guide

Benchmarks are rough and vary widely by industry, region and audience. Prefer the company's own history and targets.

## Metrics by report type

| Report | Core metrics |
| --- | --- |
| Campaign | Reach, click rate, conversion rate, cost per acquisition, return on ad spend or ROI, total conversions |
| Email | Delivered, bounces, open rate, click rate, unsubscribe rate, conversion rate |
| Social | Reach, engagement rate, follower growth, click rate, top posts |
| Paid | Spend, clicks, click rate, cost per click, cost per thousand views, conversions, cost per acquisition, return on ad spend |
| SEO | Organic sessions, ranking movement, indexed pages, new backlinks, top pages |
| Content | Views, unique visitors, time on page, bounce rate, shares, attributed conversions |
| Overall | Leads, qualified leads, pipeline contribution, customer acquisition cost, channel summary |

## Definitions and rough ranges

### Email

| Metric | Definition | Rough range |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Delivery rate | Delivered / sent | 95-99% |
| Open rate | Unique opens / delivered (inflated by privacy features in some mail apps) | 15-30% |
| Click rate | Unique clicks / delivered | 2-5% |
| Click-to-open | Unique clicks / unique opens | 10-20% |
| Unsubscribe rate | Unsubscribes / delivered | under 0.5% |
| Bounce rate | Bounces / sent | under 2% |

### Paid and social

| Metric | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Click rate | Clicks / impressions |
| Cost per click | Spend / clicks |
| Cost per thousand views | Spend / impressions x 1000 |
| Conversion rate | Conversions / clicks |
| Cost per acquisition | Spend / conversions |
| Return on ad spend | Revenue / ad spend |
| Engagement rate | (Reactions + comments + shares) / reach |
| Frequency | Average views per person (high values signal ad fatigue) |

### Pipeline

| Metric | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Qualified lead rate | Qualified leads / all leads |
| Customer acquisition cost | (Marketing + sales cost) / new customers |
| Payback period | Months of gross margin to recover acquisition cost |
| Marketing-sourced revenue | Revenue from deals marketing originated |

## Report cadences

- Weekly: top 3 metrics with change, 1-2 wins, 1-2 concerns, this week's priorities.
- Monthly: summary, metrics table with targets, channel summaries, campaign highlights, what worked and did not, recommendations, spend versus plan.
- Quarterly: results versus goals, year-to-date trajectory, channel return, experiments and lessons, next-quarter strategy and budget request.

## Attribution models

| Model | Credit goes to | Blind spot |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Last touch | Final interaction | Undervalues awareness |
| First touch | First interaction | Undervalues nurture and conversion |
| Linear | All touchpoints equally | Ignores relative impact |
| Time decay | Recent touchpoints | Undervalues awareness |
| Position-based | 40% first, 40% last, 20% middle | Weighting is arbitrary |
| Data-driven | Algorithmic | Needs high volume |

Use attribution directionally. Self-reported "how did you hear about us" is useful color, not precise data.

## Optimization levers by funnel stage

| Stage | Problem signal | Levers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Awareness | Low reach | Budget, targeting, channel mix, format |
| Interest | Low click or engagement | Creative, headline, hook, audience |
| Consideration | High bounce, short visits | Landing page relevance, speed, content |
| Conversion | Low conversion rate | Offer, CTA, form length, trust signals |
| Retention | High churn | Onboarding, nurture emails, product experience |

## Testing basics

Test one variable at a time, define success before starting, size the sample before launching, run at least one full business cycle, and record every result, including tests that confirm the current approach.
